title: Defect Spaces and Gram Operators for Tensor-Valued Incidence Maps
summary: We study vector-valued incidence maps obtained from ordinary graph incidence maps by linear observation of the free vertex space. Let $\mathbb{F}$ be a field, $D = (X, E, s, t)$ a finite directed multigraph, $U$ an $\mathbb{F}$-vector space, and $φ: X \to U$ a vertex labeling with $\mathbb{F}$-linear extension $\hatφ : \mathbb{F}^X \to U$. The vector-valued incidence map $\partial_φ: \mathbb{F}^E \to U$, $\partial_φ(\mathbf{1}_e) = φ(t(e)) - φ(s(e))$, factors as $\partial_φ= \hatφ \circ B_D$, where $B_D$ is the classical incidence map of $D$.
